blocks.text: Edit video and audio by editing text - the simplest production tool

Descript flips media editing on its head. Instead of scrubbing through timelines, you edit a text transcript - delete a sentence and the corresponding audio and video disappear. Add text and Descript's AI voice generates the audio. It makes editing accessible to anyone who can use a word processor.

For content teams producing podcasts, video tutorials, or social clips, this approach dramatically reduces production time. What used to require a skilled editor working in Premiere or Final Cut can now be done by the content creator themselves, often in a fraction of the time.

The AI capabilities go beyond editing. Descript can remove filler words automatically, generate studio-quality audio from text, create eye contact correction for webcam footage, and produce short clips optimized for social media - all from a single recording.
Edit media by editing the transcript - delete words, rearrange sections
Clone your voice to generate new audio from text
Automatically detect and remove ums, ahs, and pauses
Record presentations and tutorials with integrated editing
Auto-generate short clips optimized for social media platforms
AI audio enhancement that makes any recording sound professional

Descript removes the technical barrier from content production. For teams that want to create video and podcast content but lack dedicated editors, it is the most accessible path to professional output.
Our team can integrate Descript into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
